name: ringweave-repo
description: Repo-level tooling only. The shipped packages are lib/ (the ringweave core) and app/ (BuddyGraph); neither depends on anything here.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:oxlint && npm run lint:knip && npm run lint:hygiene
scripts.e2e: npm --prefix lib run build && npm --prefix app run build && node scripts/e2e/drive.mjs
